moment.description: Self reports and host expectations for one step.
Checks used for judgement, sealing or verification.

outcome.description: Checked and satisfied within the stated scope.
Checked and contradicted within the stated scope.
Not determined because evidence or execution was unavailable.
Inapplicable for a stated reason backed by evidence.

scope.description: Preparation feasibility within the stated model.
Faithfulness and integrity of files and records.
Coverage of the declared computable requirements.

issuer.description: A capability reporting on its own output.
A host-provided expectation evaluated by the runtime.

role.description: A capability that performs a planned action.

output_role.description: A component with material checks when applicable.
Primers requiring quality, order and reaction checks.
An analytical output; domain checks come from declarations.

run_state.description: An admitted plan has not begun execution.
The run is executing or has pending work.
A failed step awaits revision or abandonment.
No pending steps remain and failed steps have replacements.
The run was abandoned and is terminal.

step_state.description: No execution event exists for the step.
The step has started without a terminal event.
Execution and required host expectations completed.
Execution or a host expectation failed.

effects.description: No external side effect is declared.
Writes only in the supplied work directory.
Runs a local process through the execution context.

status.description: A rule is in draft form.
A rule is no longer in use.

verification_status.description: The source has no recorded human verification.
A human source-verification receipt is recorded.

review.description: Changes were requested or the record is incomplete.
An approval record matches the reviewed content.
The content differs from the review record.

actor.description: A declaration submitted by the host.

origin.description: A reason supplied with a plan or revision.
A statement matching recorded source text.

relation_basis.description: An explicit input binding has equal content hashes.
The relationship is declared rather than program-verified.

input_origin.description: A local file supplied by the user.
An observation reported by a researcher.

source_class.description: An official method or documentation source.
A declared project boundary or requirement.
A laboratory protocol or experience record.

laboratory_label.description: A laboratory operation has not been performed.

error_category.description: An operation was not admitted because input is invalid.
A capability failed to execute its contract.
A local runtime dependency or resource is unavailable.
An operation violates the declared policy.
Content or history does not match its recorded identity.

exit_code.description: The command completed; scientific outcomes are separate.
Mandatory checks refused sealing; this is not an execution error.
